items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Dexter Gordon. ... Illinois, Dexter, Arnett Cobbs, and myself, we were the famous tenor teams that he had.

ctx.x: Well -- No, this must've been because -- I probably didn't stay with Hamp -- I stayed with Hamp about a year or two, because in '44 I had left Hamp in Pittsburgh.
That's when I -- I left Hamp in Pittsburgh. We had travelled all through out the Midwest. We did like -- we had played Loew's State Theater that (inaudible) time.
